units.source_text: 小姐所居之屋，建造得特别讲究。

en.t: The house where the young lady lived had been built with particular care.

units.source_text: 一旁的板门略开一缝，以便月光射入。

en.t: A wooden door at the side was left slightly ajar so that moonlight could stream in.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便走进去，说了一些话。

en.t: Prince Genji then walked in and spoke a few words.

units.source_text: 明石姬不愿意如此迫近地接见，狼狈起来，只是唉声叹气而并无亲近之色。

en.t: The Lady of Akashi did not wish to receive him at such close quarters; flustered, she only sighed and showed no sign of intimacy.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“架子好大呵！

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "How proud she is!

units.source_text: 从来很难说服的千金小姐，一经我如此迫近地求爱，没有不软下来服从我的。

en.t: Even young ladies who were always hard to persuade would soften and yield to me once I courted them this closely.

units.source_text: 现在我倒了霉，所以要受女人侮辱了。”

en.t: Now my luck has turned, and so I must suffer humiliation at a woman's hands."
His heart was filled with deep sorrow.

units.source_text: 但念如若蛮不讲理，强要求欢，则违背自己的本意；倘说不动她的心，认输退却，则又被人取笑。

en.t: Yet he thought that if he acted unreasonably and forced his desire on her, he would betray his own true intentions; but if he failed to move her heart and withdrew in defeat, people would laugh at him.

units.source_text: 此时他那逡巡愁恨的模样，真是明石道人所谓“只合多情慧眼看”了。

en.t: At that moment, his hesitant and sorrowful appearance was truly what the Akashi monk had called something only the discerning eyes of the deeply feeling could see.
